subject: Mathematics
title: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables

questions.q: Solve x + y = 5 and x − y = 1.
questions.explanation: Adding gives 2x = 6, so x = 3 and y = 2.

questions.q: If two lines are parallel, the pair of equations has ____.
A consistent pair of linear equations has ____.
options: a unique solution or infinitely many solutions
questions.explanation: Consistent means at least one solution exists.

questions.q: If a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂, the lines are ____.
questions.explanation: The equations represent the same line.
